name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.10: Shikaku no Wana
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.10 四角の罠
source:
Jinguji is asked for a meeting. However, when he goes to the hotel where meeting is appointed, he is attacked by a masked man from behind.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有人约神宫寺见面。然而，当他来到约定的酒店时，却遭一名蒙面人从背后袭击。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
